Article 6. International cooperation on cyberinformation security 
1. International cooperation on cyberinformation security must adhere to 
the following principles:

non-intervention into one another’s internal affairs, equality, and mutual benefit;

cyberinformation security incidents, and preclusion of the taking advantage of 
cyberspace for terrorist purposes;

security.
